title: HLS Master Renditions Authoring
problem: Nako can generate selected subtitle WebVTT sidecar artifacts, but public HLS entry playlists do not advertise those media renditions through standard master playlist tags.

evidence.summary: Opened the durable fearless refactor lane for standard HLS master playlist media rendition authoring after selected subtitle sidecar artifacts became executable.
Added server-owned HLS entry playlist authoring derived from HlsArtifactManifest while preserving raw FFmpeg playlist artifacts.

Advertised selected subtitle WebVTT sidecars through EXT-X-MEDIA subtitle groups, attached SUBTITLES attributes to single-variant and adaptive stream entries, and covered quoted media group URIs in playlist rewrite and ticket decoration.
Verified transcode hls, server hls, server playback, formatting, JSON, and diff gates before closing the workstream.

continue_policy.notes: Workstream closed. Recommended follow-on is alternate audio rendition authoring through the same HLS master playlist boundary.
